title: The 5 Oldest People Ever, Ranked (#1 Was Born Before the Eiffel Tower)

scenes.text: The five oldest people ever verified, ranked. Not one of them is a man.

scenes.label: Nabi Tajima · 117 years
scenes.text: Number five: Nabi Tajima of Japan. 117 years and 260 days, born in the year 1900.

scenes.label: Lucile Randon · 118 years
scenes.text: Number four: Lucile Randon, a French nun. 118 years and 340 days. She died in 2023.

scenes.label: Sarah Knauss · 119 years
scenes.text: Number three: Sarah Knauss of the United States. 119 years and 97 days, the oldest American ever.

scenes.label: Kane Tanaka · 119 years
scenes.text: Number two: Kane Tanaka of Japan. 119 years and 107 days. Ten days more than Knauss. She died in 2022.

scenes.label: Jeanne Calment · 122 years
scenes.text: Number one: Jeanne Calment of France. 122 years and 164 days. Born in 1875, fourteen years before the Eiffel Tower. She met Van Gogh.

description:
The five oldest people ever verified, ranked by age at death.
All five are women. Jeanne Calment of France reached 122 years and 164 days, was born 14 years before the Eiffel Tower went up, and met Vincent van Gogh.
Do you think anyone will ever beat 122?
first_comment: All ten of the top ten verified oldest people are women; the oldest man reached 116. Who would you have put at number one, and what should we rank next?
